intro: Bengali culture is rich in poetry, music and festivals, and its writers include Asia's first Nobel winner in literature.

chapters.title: Poets and songs
text: Rabindranath Tagore wrote the national anthem, 'Amar Shonar Bangla'. Kazi Nazrul Islam, the 'rebel poet', is the national poet.
Baul singers wander the countryside singing mystical folk songs.

chapters.title: Festivals and food
text: Pohela Boishakh, Bengali New Year on 14 April, fills streets with colour. Eid is the biggest religious festival.
Rice and fish are the heart of the diet; hilsa is the national fish.
